query: INSERT INTO payroll_deductions (org_id, employee_id, amount_piastres, original_amount_piastres, reason, effective_date, source, attendance_record_id, reason_code, reason_vars) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (attendance_record_id, source) WHERE attendance_record_id IS NOT NULL AND source <> 'manual' DO UPDATE SET amount_piastres          = EXCLUDED.amount_piastres, original_amount_piastres = EXCLUDED.original_amount_piastres, reason                   = EXCLUDED.reason, reason_code              = EXCLUDED.reason_code, reason_vars              = EXCLUDED.reason_vars, updated_at               = now() WHERE payroll_deductions.waived_at IS NULL AND payroll_deductions.overridden_at IS NULL AND payroll_deductions.created_by IS NULL
